name: list_maps
description: Lists the maps in Brock that the person has shared with you, with their ids and whether you may edit each. Start here; you can reach nothing else.

name: read_map
description: Reads a shared map as an indented outline: every node with its id, tasks as [ ] and [x], priority, due date and notes. A map inside it that is not shared shows as a closed portal.

name: read_node
description: Reads one node of a shared map: its notes, what is under it, and what it links to and is linked from.

id.description: The node's id, from read_map or search.

name: search
description: Searches the titles and notes of the shared maps. Every word must be found; case and accents do not matter.

limit.description: How many results at most; 20 if not given.

name: add_nodes
description: Adds nodes under a node of a map you may edit. The outline is lines of text, one node each, indented to nest; start a line with - [ ] for a task. Lines without a bullet under bulleted ones become the notes of the node above. Returns the new nodes with their ids. One step that the person can undo.

parent.description: The node to add under: a map's id from list_maps, or a node's id from read_map.

outline.description:
For example:
- [ ] Buy seeds
  - Tomatoes
  - Basil
- Plan the beds

name: update_node
description: Changes a node of a map you may edit: its title, its notes (notes replaces them, append_notes adds on a new line), priority (1 most important to 5, or null to take it away) or due date (2026-11-30, or null). Give only what changes. Replacing notes loses the old ones for you, though the person can undo.

name: set_task
description: Makes a node of a map you may edit an open task, a done task, or an ordinary node again (none).

name: move_node
description: Moves a node, with what is under it, to be a child of another node, in maps you may edit: from one column of a board to another, say. It cannot move maps or the branches of a map's centre.

parent.description: The node to move it under.

position.description: Its place among the parent's children, counting from 0.

name: flag_node
description: Marks a node of a map you may edit for the person, in a colour: attention (orange, the default) when you need an answer, a decision or a review; critical (red) when you are blocked or something cannot wait; ok (green) when it is done or ready for a look, which asks nothing of them. It shows on the node and under the bell in Brock's header. Give a short reason: it is added to the node's notes. You can only raise a mark, never lower or clear one; the person does that. Usually also move the node somewhere that shows it is waiting.

reason.description: What you need, or what is done, in a sentence or two.
